# E0203: a major version declares no schemas

A major version is a group of minor versions, keyed by minor version; its first
schema is version N.0. A major version key with nothing under it declares no
schema at all.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
	}
	"1": {}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0203]: major version 1 declares no schemas
  --> lineage.cue:10:2
   |
10 |     "1": {}
   |     ^^^
   |
   = help: declare its first schema as version 1.0
```
